commonDirection: Original medieval-fantasy strategy game cinematic; expressive manga/anime linework and cel shading fused with rich hand-painted game concept art; blue crown banners versus red enemy banners; no embedded text, UI, logo, watermark, signature, or named-artist imitation.

assets.scene: The united crown and blue commander overlooking the peaceful realm.
The Ash King arrives beneath a sky of fire.
The crown shatters and four warlords receive its fragments.
The blue commander and one surviving banner refuse to kneel.
A scout reports northbound raiders and the commander raises the banner.
Faded Field defense, burned standard, raiders withdrawing north.
Northern road archer blockade and recovered sealed orders.
Silent forest, abandoned scout camp, hoofprints into fog.
Cavalry crossing the broken mountain trail toward the grove.
Forest Warlord presents the first crown fragment in black water.
Flooded mire crossing guarded by spears and chains.
Liberated villagers welcomed safely beneath blue banners.
Shielded mire garrison, causeway, iron sigil and thunder.
Storm Valley approach with lightning and hidden ridge archers.
Ridge archers and forbidden flame above the iron citadel.
Iron Warlord and the second fragment's forbidden flame.
Shattered royal caravan and knife marks across the steppe.
Dust riders surround blue shields; black banner revealed west.
Black banner on the final road, empty wells, desert footprints.
Poisoned desert wells and hidden metallic danger beneath dunes.
Sand Warlord raises the third fragment toward icy mountains.
Final fragment suspended inside the cracking frozen seal.
Winter siege, northern gate and four fragments answering.
Restored crown opens a golden road through the Infernal Gate.
Blue commander and Ash King face each other in the final citadel.
